# Research & Tasks: Dayboard (ColorLib Calendar 05)

- **Source**: ColorLib Calendar 05 (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/calendar-05/`)
- **New App Name**: `dayboard` (`@free-react-templates/dayboard`)
- **Preview URL**: `https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/bootstrap/calendar-05/`
- **Category**: Calendar & Productivity / Scheduling

## Structure & Section Order

1. **Navbar**: Branding (`Dayboard`), navigation links, date indicator, action buttons.
2. **Hero / Intro**: Title (`Calendar & Schedule Planner`), subtitle, quick date stats.
3. **Date Selectors**: Year, month, and day picker scrollers / selectors.
4. **Calendar Grid**: Full month grid with days, weekend highlights, selected day ring, and event dots.
5. **Event Management Panel**: Daily agenda list, event creation modal / form, category filters.
6. **Footer**: Copyright, quick links, mandatory Component Dock link (`https://www.componentdock.com/`).

## Design Notes & Fidelity Strategy

- Use Tailwind CSS 4 indigo/teal palette matching the clean modern calendar aesthetic.
- Recreate the column-based year/month/day selectors alongside the primary grid view.
- Ensure 100% test coverage and full responsiveness.
